fixes.text: Run only what a change can reach: no path filters or affected-only selection on PR workflows
"CodeQL / CodeQL (macos-latest)" runs 33 min in one job: shard it
4% of PR heads went green only on a rerun: track and fix flakes
A blocker most jobs wait on: "OSB / …" holds up 171 of 173 jobs, 236.6 job-min past their other needs; shorten it, or let them start setup and wait only for what they need
Jobs wait 2887 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider

notes.text: No AGENTS.md: agents working here have no instructions, such as how to run one test
